What's your size? Check out our SIZE GUIDE for an indication of the frame size that is best for you. Remember that a biomechanical evaluation with your local authorized dealer is always recommended.

ONE GR FULL CARBON INTEGRATED The OИE GR full carbon integrated handlebar is designed for the Gravel Racing world. Designed for total cable integration, it improves performance in terms of stiffness and aerodynamics and ensures high comfort thanks to the opening optimized for rough terrain. Technical info WEIGHT 390 grams FLARE 12° MEASURES 38x80, 40x90, 42x100, 44x110

C-WAVE TECHNOLOGY With C WAVE technology, a special layup of high modulus carbon fibers has been created which, applied to the points of greatest stress, allows for improved frame rigidity without compromising weight and vibration absorption. These particular fiber weaves are applied in strategic points that allow for optimizing resistance and rigidity: head tube, seat tube and bottom bracket.

Discover the new ITM wheels Find out more about the ITM wheels developed exclusively for Bottecchia. FIND OUT MORE

RACING TECHNOLOGIES DEPARTMENT The Gravel Overland frame is implemented to increase the racing spirit for the FAST GRAVEL world. Thanks to the new carbon processing and the absence of bike packing predispositions, a weight reduction of 980 grams is achieved. With the new carbon layout, rigidity also benefits, without compromising vibration absorption even on rough terrain. The sloping geometries are slightly elongated for a racing-comfort riding setting, with lowered steering and slightly more open angles. Aerodynamics are significantly improved thanks to the dedicated carbon aero seatpost, the integrated clamp and the new ONE GR full carbon integrated handlebar. 50mm wheel clearance specifically designed to improve aerodynamics and avoid blocking on muddy terrain. IDEAL FOR GRAVEL SL is ready to compete in the UCI World Championships. A winner in competitions, it is ideal for competing at the highest levels on different terrains, from dirt, to gravel, from mud to asphalt passages. PERFECT FOR YOU IF If you want a fast, lightweight bike to compete in gravel racing, whether it’s a 200km one-day ride or an ultra-cycling race.
